interface.longDescription: Agent skills to design, review and test admin dashboards. Build screens from a brief, add empty, loading and error states, design onboarding, review a codebase or a running app, and polish the visual layer, using 183 UI rules reverse-engineered from public, logged-in admin panels. Every finding cites a rule ID. Skills only: no MCP server, no hooks. Independent project; no vendor endorses it.
